name: Correct p37q3 unrestricted LP333 Kissat SAT discovery
hypothesis: The exact prescribed length-37 compression, strengthened by 74 exact size-nine margins and quotiented by its full 216-action decimation and sequence-swap group, may yield a directly verifiable unrestricted Legendre pair under pinned Kissat SAT search.
evidence_unit: one proofless SAT-discovery run on the audited unrestricted ID0 pq2 p37q3 slice with Kissat 4.0.4 --sat, seed zero, and a 7200-second cap
claim_boundary: The uncompression statement is conjectural. Only a complete assignment satisfying all 4394496 serialized clauses and independently verifying two binary length-333 rows, all 74 prescribed compression margins, and combined PAF minus two at all 332 nonzero shifts is a candidate. Proofless UNSAT is nondecisive.

baseline.evidence: Correct formula SHA-256 99b7749b41a0eb81d235cda71e27d93241ee6fe4ee34361988fc5e3117cc1dea, 700291 variables, 4394496 clauses, and independent formula audit status pass.
baseline.measurement: No directly verified SAT model exists in the campaign for the source-correct prescribed rows [1,3 chi_37] and [1,-3 chi_37].

intervention.one_change: Search the audited correct p37q3 unrestricted formula with official pinned Kissat 4.0.4 in --sat mode, default seed zero, no proof output, and no configuration portfolio.
forbidden_confounds: accepting a partial or unaudited model

controls.name: correct-formula-reconstruction
controls.purpose: Bind the specialization and every structural addition.
controls.expected: The independent audit verifies 333=37*3^2, compressed energy 650, nonzero compressed PAF -18, all 215 lex leaders with 850182 clauses, all 74 counters with 9872 serialized clauses, the exact formula hash, and a rejected mutation.

controls.name: compression-symmetry-group
controls.purpose: Ensure the quotient preserves the ordered p37q3 seed.
controls.expected: All 216 units act once, with sequence swap exactly for quadratic nonresidues modulo 37, and all 74 margins remain fixed.

controls.name: official-tool-pin
controls.expected: Kissat 4.0.4, binary SHA-256 ca26c445800f6a88caebe925ee5b60d0907da4f1c8418f4044a51b1a22224983, source revision 8af8e56f174b778aef3aa45af9f739b2a5f492c2, and the already passing upstream test suite.

controls.name: sat-positive-control
controls.purpose: Check SAT status and complete-model extraction before target search.
controls.expected: The pinned solver returns SAT on known SAT ID3 cell 73 and its complete assignment satisfies every serialized control clause.

controls.name: direct-target-model-audit
controls.purpose: Separate solver status from mathematical evidence.
controls.expected: Any SAT assignment satisfies every CNF clause and independently verifies both full rows, all 74 margins, and every combined PAF equation; a controlled mutation is rejected.

primary_metric.name: directly verified unrestricted correct-p37q3 SAT models

terminal_outcomes.promote: Kissat returns SAT and the complete assignment passes the exact CNF and independent direct full-length mathematical audit.
terminal_outcomes.park: The run reaches its cap or returns proofless UNSAT without a SAT model while all controls remain valid.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: A wall, memory, tool, extraction, or verification ceiling interrupts the frozen arm.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any factorization, formula, tool, positive-control, symmetry, margin, complete-model, CNF, direct-PAF, or mutation control fails.

stop_rules: Require the passing independent correct-p37q3 formula audit before launch.
Run only pinned Kissat 4.0.4 --sat with seed zero.
Stop immediately on a directly verified SAT model.
Otherwise terminate at 7200 solver seconds or 4 GiB observed RSS.
Do not rerun with another seed, mode, formula, or larger cap.

next_actions.promote: Freeze the pair, construct H668, independently verify orthogonality and artifact hashes, and package it for the gated submission workflow.
next_actions.park: Archive the non-SAT manifest and move to a distinct structural search mechanism.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the interrupted manifest and resume only the remaining frozen budget if the interruption is reproducible.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest formula, tool, extraction, or direct-verification defect before rerunning.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts, source-pinned repositories, official open-source solver code, and public primary literature are authorized for the autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared; actual external submission remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
